metadata.title: Live Work Item view
metadata.description: Puts the live view at the top of a Work Item page: the stages as folds, one sentence on what the agent is doing, and the flight path where every Run is a hop whose height follows its tool calls, machine failures bounce back, a stalled Run holds and tripwires and a judge's verdicts are marked. Below it, questions answered from the record. Takes the place of the four-stage strip and the flight profile.
